deterministic_data.verification: Final Workbench assembly is 13/13 ready with zero errors and warnings; Factory canonical validation is also clean. Contract-only DTO identities and every tagged sum type are closed in 60_model_closure_contract_types.json.

modules.summary: Domain models, contract-only DTOs, opaque runtime carriers and tagged sum types are structurally closed; the CompositionView item uses a non-callable discriminator distinct from flow_registry.composition_view. AuthenticationFailureDelayRule is the contract-only row model of the data_provider back-off table.

Typed constants only, emitted by data_provider_backend/v1 (python_constant_data_v1). Every constant is lowered from one rules address named in lowered_from and carries exactly that value; no behavior, no lookup, no default.

The module is the sole authority for wall and elapsed time. system_clock_backend/v3 emits exactly now and monotonic_ns under time_source_policy/v1; monotonic_ns is intentionally internal and injected into elapsed-time consumers.
All 9 owned contracts are covered by 9 assembled constraints and accepted evidence; adversarial review found no materially different observable implementation.

The protected JSON configuration contract, exact key schema and credential-purpose policy close host configuration; load_installation is intentionally internal. Configuration key names, format version, file-mode bound and the purpose vocabulary arrive as imported data_provider constants, and every function of the module names keys only through them.

The typed OperationalUnitOfWork and deterministic SQLite repository close durable staging, reads and commit/rollback; open_store is intentionally internal. Store layout names and the three continuity states arrive as imported data_provider constants; the schema stays owned by create_operational_store_schema.

Typed durable throttle/delegation access plus installation-owned credential resolution close authentication; establish_owner is intentionally an internal startup callable.
